artifact.kind: release-signed Android APK installed in place

checks.name: Single-app MediaProjection visibility event
checks.observation: With the microphone muted, selected Clock as the sole app source in SHARE_TEST, then brought the existing BOOHTACORD activity forward. Android emitted projection_content_visibility=hidden for the active capture; the matching track event reached Flutter and replaced the indefinite first-frame spinner with a Russian explanation that Android hid the selected app. The screenshot showed the recent Clock frame dimmed beneath the explanation.

checks.name: Stop and leave cleanup
checks.observation: Stopped from the app UI; logcat recorded projection_app_stop, dumpsys media_projection returned null, and the app returned to the SHARE_TEST prejoin screen after leaving.

limitations: Emulator-only; physical Pixel acceptance remains open.
No paired browser or macOS receiver was connected, so remote publication, decoded frames, receiver crop and correlated metrics were not checked.
The hidden-source notice makes the source state honest but does not fix or prove the Android local viewer texture/compositor path when the app is visible.
remaining: Repeat app-only and resume tests on Pixel with a paired browser/macOS receiver; correlate sender and receiver frame counters and verify decoded pixels before closing FE-59.
